newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet spreads stable, demand for EFP plays.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet spreads stable, demand for EFP plays.

text.p: NWE jet fuel barges remained tight at unchanged premiums on Thursday and sporadic business was done on an exchange for physical basis, traders said.
August IPE last traded down $1.75 a tonne at $169.25.
Premiums were seen unchanged from a pipeline delivery deal done on Wednesday at August IPE +$19.

Cargoes have traded on a quotes-related basis around quotes fob high NWE +$2 or +$3. Supply from the U.K. remains thin. Demand from France is quiet. Nevertheless speculative demand remained high for exchange for physical deals.
